UDP 443 is dropped, browsers fall back to TCP
Stop and start again for the change to apply
Switch to a working method by itself

Every time you connect or switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, the chosen method is really tried on the sites in the Test card. If it does not open them, the other methods are tried and the one that works is used and saved for that network. A method you picked by hand is never changed.
Another method works here: run the test and apply the recommended one.
The test sites open without splitting: they are not blocked on this network. Put sites that are blocked for you in the Test card.
Encrypted DNS (DoH) cannot be reached, so the sites could not be tried. Pick another DNS provider, turn off Private DNS in the phone settings, or check your internet connection.
No internet connection on this network.
Even a plain connection to the sites is not possible: this looks like an IP block. Splitting cannot get around it; only a real VPN or proxy can.
The sites answer with a wrong certificate: something on this network (operator, modem or school/company filter) intercepts the connection. Splitting cannot get around it.
The connection is made but the filter catches every method on this network. Send a report so it can be looked at.
Splits at byte 1 and sends the first piece with TTL 1, so it dies before the filter and is resent; the server gets the pieces out of order.
Splits in the middle of the domain name; the first piece is sent with TTL 1 and resent later.
Two TLS records cut in the middle of the site name; the first one is sent with TTL 1 and resent later.

If it does not work, send a report. It contains your network and operator, the settings and the last test results. It does not contain the sites you visit, only the sites in the test box above. You see it before it is sent.
No e-mail app found, choose another app
e.g. Discord does not open, Türk Telekom fiber, home Wi-Fi. Which sites or apps, since when?
No method saved for any network yet. Pick a method or run the test on each network.
Encrypted DNS (DoH) only. The ClientHello is not split.
A single split in the middle of the domain name.
Splits at byte 1 and at the start of the SNI.
Many-piece split (1, 3, SNI start, middle of the domain, SNI end).
Splits at byte 1 and in the middle of the domain name, then sends 1 OOB (urgent) byte after the first piece.
The ClientHello is cut in the middle of the site name into two TLS records, sent as two TCP pieces.
Tries every method on this network with a real TLS handshake against the sites below. Use sites that are blocked for you; the defaults are only examples.
No method could open any domain
certificate does not match the host name

Your DNS queries are encrypted (DoH). Site traffic does not go to an intermediary server, it leaves directly; HTTPS sites already use their own encryption. This app is not a privacy VPN: your carrier can still see which IP addresses you connect to.
Notification permission was not granted: the status notification will not appear
